gloss: mouse (the animal; also the computer mouse)
slide, slip (move smoothly over a surface)
form (format; a form to fill in)
wonder, an astonishing unexplained event (miracle is built: wonder of god)
status, standing, rank in a group
discrimination, unfair treatment of a group
roast (cook over a fire or in dry heat)
plant, sow (put seeds or plants in the ground)
orphan, a child whose parents have died
shell (of egg, nut, snail, sea creature)
fry (cook in hot oil or fat)
bake (in an oven or on hot ashes)
stranger, a person one does not know
